target.title: ci: stabilize Apple simulator builds
target.body:
## Summary

- select Xcode 16.4 consistently for macOS and Apple simulator CI jobs
- keep the restored iOS, tvOS, watchOS, and visionOS matrix unchanged

## Why

The current `macos-15` ARM image no longer provisions Xcode 16.1 platform runtimes consistently. The post-merge main run for #4 failed iOS and watchOS with exit 70 because the selected Xcode reported every 16.1 Apple platform as not installed; a prior PR attempt showed the same host-side failure for iOS. Xcode 16.4 and its corresponding platform runtimes are present in the current runner image.

Failed main proof: https://github.com/steipete/Commander/actions/runs/28522050087

## Validation

- `actionlint .github/workflows/ci.yml`
- Ruby YAML parse
- `git diff --check`
- `autoreview --mode local` — clean; no accepted/actionable findings

Risk: low. One workflow file, no runtime source or package metadata changes.
